title: Annual USDA crop classes, Iowa State crop records, and soil map units at the Marsden farm trial

reference_2020_summary.reference_definition: Use the crop phase when the 2020 experiment layout and harvest crop key agree. The oat phase can include a companion forage that is not counted as a second required crop class.

irrigation_context.scope: Boone County, Iowa, 2022 Census of Agriculture, Table 10

methods: Match the 36 numbered plot geometries from the published plot ID crosswalk. Exclude the three non-treatment strips with GIS IDs 0, 10 and 29. The selected plots cover 13.64 acres.

Retrieve the single-band unstyled USDA CroplandCROS categorical exports with nearest-neighbour resampling in NAD83 / Conus Albers (EPSG:5070). Use one fixed bounding box and grid origins, 30 m for 2020–2023 and 10 m for 2024–2025. This uses the live service rather than reading directly from each full national raster archive.

Intersect each raster cell footprint with the study plots in EPSG:5070. Sum the fractional overlap by original CDL class code. The dominant class for a plot is the one with the most mapped area. The centre check uses the plot centroid.

Join the soil map unit polygons by the analysis footprint. Use the Iowa CSR2 field (mapunit.iacornsr in Soil Data Access) and weight by overlap area. Retain original map unit classifications, soil survey date and drainage conditions.

Treat the 2021–2025 mapped classes as map observations for the historical trial footprint. No independent field logs are used to score those years. County irrigated and equipped acreage do not establish the study site’s water use or permitted supply.

ssurgo.source_query: SELECT m.mupolygonkey, m.mukey, m.mupolygongeo.STAsText() AS polygon_wkt, u.musym, u.muname, u.iacornsr AS iowa_csr2, u.farmlndcl, l.areasymbol, CONVERT(varchar(10), s.saverest, 23) AS survey_saved FROM SDA_Get_Mupolygonkey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('POLYGON ((-93.78624049641213 42.01286904925821, -93.78206238279688 42.01286904925821, -93.78206238279688 42.014543861566075, -93.78624049641213 42.014543861566075, -93.78624049641213 42.01286904925821))') AS k JOIN mupolygon AS m ON m.mupolygonkey = k.mupolygonkey JOIN mapunit AS u ON u.mukey = m.mukey JOIN legend AS l ON l.lkey = u.lkey LEFT JOIN sacatalog AS s ON s.areasymbol = l.areasymbol ORDER BY m.mukey, m.mupolygonkey
